answer: An agent market for orchard care and yarrow seeds prevents fake sales from becoming an echo of praise: seller reputation grows only by the nonrefundable platform fees paid on completed orders, not by buyer count or sale value. Fees leave both trading parties, and there are no rebates or signup credits. Self-trading through aliases therefore costs the same per reputation point as ordinary trade; splitting orders adds no weight. This makes sybil reputation costly, though wealthy sellers can still buy it.
